components.name: Wide Open Source Grid Experiment
components.description: An experimental grid-based layout system where ten DOM cards rearrange into five authored compositions plus derived mirrored variants, choreographed with out/in staggered clip-path transitions. An optional WebGL 'beast mode' overlays a GLSL directional blur that samples the existing images along the pointer direction with fbm noise and dithering.

components.name: Drawing With Light: Lit GPU Tubes with TSL and WebGPU
components.description: A tube geometry system whose triangles never change: positions and normals are derived per-vertex in TSL on the WebGPU renderer from a progress/angle parameter grid, letting real lit tubes be swept along curves without CPU rebuilds. Includes a written walkthrough of four cross-section frame strategies and why no stateless orthonormal basis can stay continuous for every tangent.

components.name: Unwoven Infinite Loom Image Marquee
components.description: An endless horizontal Three.js marquee where each image card is built from 26 independent ribbon geometries instead of one plane. A shader derives a per-card 'tear' value from viewport edges so ribbons slide at random speeds, open gaps and bleach into the page as cards weave in and unravel out.

components.name: ULTRAGRID Isometric 3D Portfolio Navigation
components.description: A case study on a portfolio whose homepage navigation is an isometric Blender scene exported to Spline, where each object on the desk is a link to a page with native hover and click events. Covers material rebuilding, GLB optimization (decimation, WebP textures, flattened armatures) and embedding the Spline runtime in a Webflow code embed gated by the page loader.

components.name: The Drive Windshield Wiper Landing Page
components.description: A winning landing-page concept built with Astro and GSAP around a hard-edged windshield-wiper wipe, photo-luminance text masking, and a single shared blood-droplet engine (surface tension, stick-and-slip, merging) driving the cursor trail, link smears and hero. Also covers a red line-city map rendered as tens of thousands of columns in one draw call.

components.name: Eiffel Tower Catapult Physics Playground
components.description: An interactive Three.js scene where the Eiffel Tower acts as a deformable spring launcher: dragging bends the tower and stores energy, releasing flings you across Paris toward the conference venue. Combines interactive mesh deformation and physics with real-world geospatial 3D tiles streamed from Cesium ion.

components.name: Garden Anomaly WebGPU TSL Sphere Experiment
components.description: A small WebGPU and TSL experiment that binds physics simulation, glass deformation and procedural audio together inside a sphere you can play with, published as an open-source starting point for people unsure where to begin with Three Shading Language.

components.name: On-Scroll 3D Carousel with Page Transition
components.description: A scroll experiment that rotates a carousel of panels in 3D as the page moves, paired with a GSAP page transition using the rewritten SplitText and ScrollSmoother plugins. Presented as a proof of concept for balancing 3D motion against flat-screen scroll.

components.name: Animating in Frames: Repeating Image Transition
components.description: A sliced repetition effect that animates repeated frames of the same image along a path through a grid, inspired by Joana Correia's motion design. Each grid item overrides the animation with data attributes for clip-path direction, number of mover steps and per-step duration.

components.name: Scroll-based SVG Filter Animations on Text
components.description: A small set of SVG filter animations applied to HTML headings rather than SVG text, triggered as you scroll, with per-heading replay buttons for inspecting the distortion. Demonstrates that SVG filters can be driven by GSAP on plain DOM text across browsers.

components.name: Buoy

components.name: Sea Creature

components.name: Luminescence

components.name: Abstract Corridor
components.description: Triangle noise and a curvature function fake a flat-shaded, point-lit mesh tunnel corridor.

components.name: Truchet + Kaleidoscope FTW

components.name: Kaleidoscope Tunnel
components.description: 2D iterated-fold IFS tunnel with kaleidoscopic symmetry and a VJ-inspired neon tunnel zoom.

components.name: Fractured Orb

components.name: Crystal Drops

components.name: Iridescent crystals
components.description: Raymarched chamfered dodecahedron crystals shaded with thin-film iridescence across each facet.

components.name: Auroras
components.description: Fully procedural northern lights with large-scale band-like curtain trails evaluated across a large atmospheric volume.

components.name: Polar Night

components.name: Glitch transform
components.description: Icosahedron/dodecahedron blend where the block-swap glitch displacement travels with the rotating model.

components.name: mpeg artifacts

components.name: Vorocracks marble

components.name: Playing marble
components.description: Volumetric 3D fractal marble texture, a dense swirling stone pattern with layered fractal detail.

components.name: Lichtenberg figure 4
components.description: Greyscale branching lightning figure drawn by plotting millions of Monte Carlo points along a squiggly forked line.

components.name: Zippy Zaps
components.description: Compact raymarched storm-and-lightning scene with glowing electric zaps and hot bloom across the frame.

components.name: Chromatic Resonance
components.description: Audio-reactive colour experiment mapping a spectrum of sines and music input onto flowing chromatic visuals.

components.name: accent-color
components.description: Re-tints the accent color the browser applies to native form controls such as checkboxes, radios and progress bars, so you can match them to a design with a single declaration instead of rebuilding the controls.

components.name: anchor-name
components.description: Registers an element as a named "anchor" that other elements can be positioned against, the foundation of CSS Anchor Positioning for tooltips, popovers and dropdowns that track their trigger.

components.name: animation-range
components.description: Controls when a scroll-driven view-timeline animation starts and stops, letting you pin the animation range to entry, exit or the full cover range of the element in the viewport.

components.name: animation-timeline
components.description: Links an animation's progress to timelines beyond the document timeline, so animations can be driven by scroll position or by an element entering the viewport instead of elapsed time.

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.description: Maintains proportional box dimensions by calculating height from width as a ratio, so elements keep their shape as they grow or shrink.

components.name: backdrop-filter
components.description: Applies filter effects such as blur, grayscale and contrast to an element's backdrop rather than its content, the basis of frosted-glass surfaces layered over imagery.

components.name: background-blend-mode
components.description: Controls how an element's background image blends with its background color using Photoshop-style blend modes, without affecting the element's own text content.

components.name: border-image
components.description: Shorthand that lets you use an image or CSS gradient as an element's border by slicing the source into nine regions and assigning corners, edges and center.

components.name: caret-shape
components.description: Changes the shape of the blinking text cursor inside editable elements from the default bar to a block or an underscore, for a command-line style typing effect.

components.name: color-scheme
components.description: Lets the browser apply its own dark or light default styling to native widgets, so form controls, scrollbars and focus rings follow the user's system color preference.

components.name: container-type
components.description: Registers an element as a size container for container queries, letting descendants respond to the container's own inline size rather than to viewport media queries.

components.name: corner-shape
components.description: Defines the geometric shape of an element's corners, used alongside border-radius to produce rounded, squared, beveled, notched or squircle corner styles.

components.name: cursor
components.description: Controls which mouse cursor shape is shown over an element, covering pointer, grab, grabbing, crosshair, zoom and resize cursors used to signal affordance.

components.name: field-sizing
components.description: Lets inputs, selects and textareas grow automatically to fit their content instead of needing a fixed size, so form controls size themselves to the data.

components.name: filter
components.description: Applies visual effects to an element's rendering before it is displayed, including blur, brightness, contrast, drop-shadow, grayscale, hue-rotate, invert, saturate and sepia.

components.name: font-feature-settings
components.description: Gives control over advanced OpenType typographic features such as ligatures, small caps and swashes by naming the feature and switching it on or off.

components.name: initial-letter
components.description: Styles the first letter of a block of text and specifies how many lines it should span, automatically computing the font size needed for a proper drop cap with no extra markup.

components.name: interpolate-size
components.description: Enables transitioning an element from a fixed length to its intrinsic size such as min-content, so links and labels can expand to their natural width on hover instead of guessing a width.

components.name: line-clamp
components.description: Truncates text at a specified number of lines and appends an ellipsis, shorthand for max-lines and block-overflow in the current spec draft.

components.name: mix-blend-mode
components.description: Defines how an element's content should blend with its own backdrop, letting text or shapes interact with an image behind them via exclusion, multiply, screen and other blend modes.

components.name: object-fit
components.description: Defines how a replaced element such as an image or video responds to the size of its content box, with fill, contain, cover, none and scale-down controlling cropping and letterboxing.

components.name: offset-path
components.description: Defines a movement path for an element to follow during animation, formerly motion-path, paired with offset-distance to animate progress along an SVG path.

components.name: overscroll-behavior
components.description: Controls scroll chaining and overscroll affordances, deciding whether reaching a scrolling area's boundary passes the scroll on to the parent or stays contained.

components.name: overflow-wrap
components.description: Lets the browser break a line of text at an otherwise unbreakable point inside the target element, preventing long unbroken strings from causing layout overflow.

components.name: paint-order
components.description: Sets the order in which SVG shapes and text are painted, so reversing fill and stroke lets a text fill cover the inner half of its stroke for clean outlined lettering.

components.name: perspective
components.description: Gives an element a 3D space by setting the distance between the Z plane and the viewer, so all transformed children share one vanishing point rather than each getting depth individually.

components.name: place-items
components.description: Shorthand combining align-items and justify-items into one declaration, most commonly used to center content horizontally and vertically in a Grid or Flex container.

components.name: pointer-events
components.description: Controls whether an element can become the target of pointer events such as clicks and hover states, letting overlays sit on top without intercepting interaction underneath.

components.name: position-try-fallbacks
components.description: Tries a list of comma-separated positioning options for a target element against its anchor, falling through to the next option when the first runs out of available space.

components.name: resize
components.description: Controls whether and how a user can resize an element by dragging its corner handle, requiring overflow to be set to something other than visible to take effect.

components.name: rotate
components.description: Rotates an element around one or more axes independently of the transform property, adding the ability to rotate along the Z-axis that transform: rotate() does not provide.

components.name: scale
components.description: Resizes an element's width and height proportionally, independently of the transform property, accepting one to three values for the X, Y and Z axes.

components.name: scroll-behavior
components.description: Decides whether the browser jumps or smoothly animates when a link targets an anchored position inside a scrolling box, applied to the html element for whole-page smooth scrolling.

components.name: scroll-snap-align
components.description: Tells the browser which part of an element should align to the snapport when a snap point is encountered, with start, center and end values for block and inline axes.

components.name: scroll-snap-type
components.description: Enables scroll snapping on a scroll container, declaring the axis to snap on and whether snapping is mandatory or only engages when the user gets close to a snap position.

components.name: scrollbar-color
components.description: Styles the two colors of a scrollbar, its thumb and its track, so scrollbars can match a design without hiding them and rebuilding them in JavaScript.

components.name: scrollbar-width
components.description: Controls the thickness of a scrollbar, which matters in cramped interfaces such as a textarea inside a narrow container where every pixel of scrollbar eats into the content area.

components.name: shape-outside
components.description: Controls how content wraps around a floated element's bounding box, letting text reflow along a circle, ellipse or polygon so an image can sit inside a blob-shaped hole in a paragraph.

components.name: stroke-dasharray
components.description: Sets the length pattern of alternating dashes and gaps in an SVG shape's stroke, the first half of the classic line-drawing animation technique.

components.name: stroke-dashoffset
components.description: Defines the point along an SVG path where a stroke's dash pattern begins, animated to produce the line-drawing effect where a stroked path appears to draw itself.

components.name: stroke-linecap
components.description: Sets the starting and ending points of a stroke on SVG shapes with butt, square and round values, so icon and logo strokes can have caps that suit the design.

components.name: text-box-trim
components.description: Clips the whitespace above and below text so headings sit tight against surrounding layout, used with text-box-edge to specify how much of the text box is trimmed.

components.name: text-overflow
components.description: Handles text that overflows its box by clipping it or rendering an ellipsis, requiring overflow to be hidden or auto and white-space to be nowrap.

components.name: text-shadow
components.description: Applies one or more shadows to text using x-offset, y-offset, blur radius and color values, and the classic recipe for neon and retro glowing lettering.

components.name: text-stroke
components.description: Experimental shorthand for text-stroke-width and text-stroke-color that outlines glyphs like vector drawing software, paired with text-fill-color for a graceful fallback color.

components.name: text-wrap-style
components.description: Controls how text lines wrap, choosing between filling each line in turn and balancing the text as words are written so short headings come out even on both sides.

components.name: transform-style
components.description: Determines whether an element's children are positioned in real 3D space or flattened onto a plane, with preserve-3d being what keeps depth inside a rotated parent.

components.name: view-transition-class
components.description: Groups multiple named elements under a common class so they share the same view-transition animation styles, letting a set of transitioning elements be styled together.

components.name: view-transition-name
components.description: Uniquely identifies an element as a participant in a view transition, tagging individually transitioning subtrees so they can animate between old and new states.

components.name: will-change
components.description: Lets you hint which properties are about to be manipulated so the browser can prepare and optimize them ahead of an animation.

components.name: writing-mode
components.description: Sets whether lines of text are laid out horizontally or vertically and the direction blocks and lines progress in, used for CJK typography and vertical headings.

components.name: gap
components.description: Shorthand for row-gap and column-gap that sets the size of the gutters between rows and columns in CSS Grid, Flexbox, and multi-column layouts.

components.name: grid-area
components.description: Shorthand that places and sizes a grid item by setting grid-row-start, grid-column-start, grid-row-end and grid-column-end in one declaration, overriding the grid's auto-placement.

components.name: grid-column
components.description: Shorthand that sets the column grid lines where a grid item starts and ends, letting an item span multiple columns instead of auto-placing into one.

components.name: grid-row
components.description: Shorthand that specifies the row grid lines where a grid item starts and ends, used together with grid-row-start and grid-row-end.

components.name: hanging-punctuation
components.description: Pushes punctuation such as opening quotes or bullets outside the text box so the first real letter aligns with the rest of the document, preserving reading flow.

components.name: hyphenate-character
components.description: Sets the character appended at the end of a line that wraps to the next one, letting you swap the default hyphen for a custom string.

components.name: hyphenate-limit-chars
components.description: Controls how many characters a word must have before hyphenation kicks in and the minimum characters allowed before and after the hyphen, avoiding awkward breaks.

components.name: hyphens
components.description: Controls hyphenation of text in block-level elements with none, manual and auto values; behavior is language-sensitive and depends on the lang attribute.

components.name: image-rendering
components.description: Defines how a scaled image is rendered, with crisp-edges and pixelated values that skip the browser's smoothing so pixel art, icons and diagrams stay sharp.

components.name: inline-size
components.description: Logical property that sets width when writing-mode is horizontal and height when it is vertical, so layouts survive a 90 degree flow change.

components.name: inset
components.description: Shorthand for the four inset offsets — top, right, bottom and left — with padding-style clockwise value syntax; only affects elements with a non-static position.

components.name: justify-content
components.description: Flexbox sub-property that aligns items along the main axis and distributes leftover free space, accepting flex-start, center, space-between, space-around and space-evenly.

components.name: justify-items
components.description: Box Alignment property that aligns grid items inside their grid area along the row (inline) axis and sets the default justify-self value for all children.

components.name: justify-self
components.description: Aligns a single grid item along the inline axis, overriding the container's justify-items value for that one element.

components.name: letter-spacing
components.description: Controls the space between each letter; the value is added to the font's default spacing rather than replacing it, and negative values tighten type.

components.name: line-break
components.description: Sets how strictly line-wrapping rules are enforced, particularly for symbols and punctuation in Chinese, Japanese and Korean writing systems.

components.name: line-height
components.description: Sets the leading above and below inline elements; it accepts normal, lengths, percentages and unitless numbers, with normal computing to a font-appropriate value.

components.name: list-style
components.description: Shorthand combining list-style-type, list-style-position and list-style-image, where omitted values revert to their initial state.

components.name: margin
components.description: Defines the outermost portion of the box model, creating space around an element outside any border; accepts lengths, percentages, negative values and auto.

components.name: margin-trim
components.description: Removes the stray margin a container inherits when its last child bumps right up against the container edge, e.g. margin-trim: block-end on a list.

components.name: mask
components.description: Shorthand for all mask-* properties that hides part of the element it is applied to, accepting one or more comma-separated mask layers each with its own reference, position, size, repeat and mode.

components.name: mask-border
components.description: Applies a border image to an element's masked border area, shorthand for mask-border-source, slice, width, outset, repeat and mode.

components.name: mask-image
components.description: Sets the image used as a mask, hiding parts of the element it is applied to — pair it with mask-size, mask-repeat and mask-position to control the mask itself.

components.name: mask-composite
components.description: Combines multiple mask layer images into one final mask using add, subtract, intersect or exclude operators, like compositing layers in Photoshop or Figma.

components.name: max-width
components.description: Caps the width of an element, overriding width while min-width always wins; the classic use is constraining a full-width wrapper to a readable measure.

components.name: max-height
components.description: Sets the maximum height of an element, overriding height but always yielding to min-height; percentages resolve against the containing block's height.

components.name: min-width
components.description: Sets a floor for an element's width, overriding width whether declared before or after it; best paired with a percentage width rather than an absolute one.

components.name: min-height
components.description: Sets the minimum height of an element, always overriding both height and max-height, useful for equal-height cards and click targets.

components.name: object-position
components.description: Aligns a replaced element such as an img, iframe, video or embed inside the box that contains it, using keywords or length/percentage pairs.

components.name: offset-anchor
components.description: Defines the point inside the element's box that travels along an offset-path, so a box follows an SVG squiggle via offset-distance rather than raw offsets.

components.name: offset-distance
components.description: Sets how far along an offset-path an element sits and is the animatable property for motion paths — animate it from 0% to 100% to trace the path.

components.name: offset-rotate
components.description: Controls an element's angle based on its offset-distance along an offset-path; the default auto value keeps a moving object like a race car facing its direction of travel.

components.name: order
components.description: Flexbox sub-property that changes the visual order of flex items, which otherwise render in the same order they appear in the source document.

components.name: orphans
components.description: Sets the minimum number of paragraph lines left behind on the old page when a paragraph splits; pairs with widows and affects paged media and columns.

components.name: overflow
components.description: Controls what happens to content that breaks outside its bounds, with visible, hidden, scroll and auto deciding whether it spills, is cut off or gets a scrollbar.

components.name: overflow-clip-margin
components.description: Sets how far overflowing content may extend past an element's box before overflow: clip cuts it, choosing a visual box and a length to widen that clip edge.

components.name: overlay
components.description: Reports whether an element is rendered in the top layer (dialogs, popovers); it can't be set manually, but transition-behavior: allow-discrete lets you animate the value.

components.name: padding
components.description: Defines the innermost portion of the box model, creating space between an element's content and its margins or borders; takes lengths and percentages, never negatives.

components.name: page-break
components.description: Legacy trio of page-break-before, page-break-after and page-break-inside that shapes how a document paginates when printed, being superseded by the generic break-* properties.

components.name: place-content
components.description: Shorthand for align-content and justify-content in Grid and Flexbox containers; a single value sets both, two values set block then inline alignment.

components.name: place-self
components.description: Self-alignment shorthand combining align-self and justify-self so an individual grid or flex item can align itself apart from its parent and siblings.

components.name: position
components.description: Manipulates where an element sits in the flow — static, relative, absolute, fixed or sticky — so offsets like top and left can be applied.

components.name: position-area
components.description: Creates an imaginary 3x3 grid around an anchor element and places an anchor-positioned target in one region or spanning several — the easy path to CSS tooltips and popovers.

components.name: quotes
components.description: Specifies the quote glyphs inserted by content: open-quote and close-quote, with the first pair used at the top level and later pairs for nested quotations.

components.name: right
components.description: One of the top/bottom/left/right offset properties used with position to place an element; only affects positioned elements and moves away from the side on positive values.

components.name: scroll-timeline-axis
components.description: Chooses whether a scroll timeline is driven by horizontal or vertical scrolling, telling the browser which axis motion should trigger the animation.

components.name: scroll-timeline-name
components.description: Names a scroll timeline so animation-timeline can bind to it, letting keyframe animations progress purely as an element is scrolled — no JS scroll listeners.

components.name: scrollbar
components.description: Overview of scrollbar styling across eras: the dead IE -ms- properties, the seven ::-webkit-scrollbar pseudo-elements still used in Safari and Chrome, and the standardized scrollbar-color and scrollbar-width.

components.name: scrollbar-gutter
components.description: Reserves space for the scrollbar so content does not reflow when one appears, giving a consistent layout whether the browser uses classic or overlay scrollbars.

components.name: shape-image-threshold
components.description: Decides which pixels count as part of the shape when shape-outside uses an image, so a gradient's transparent half stops contributing to the float area.

components.name: shape-margin
components.description: Adds margin around a shape created with shape-outside, spacing text flowing past it away from the floated shape's edge.

components.name: stroke
components.description: Adds a border to SVG shapes, accepting any CSS color or even a pattern referenced from a defs element; it overrides presentation attributes but not inline styles.

components.name: stroke-linejoin
components.description: Defines how two SVG path lines meet at a corner, sharpening or softening joints with values like miter, round and bevel alongside stroke-miterlimit.

components.name: stroke-width
components.description: Sets the thickness of a stroke on SVG shapes; unitless numbers resolve against the viewBox coordinate system, so 5 renders as 5% in a 0 0 100 100 viewBox.

components.name: tab-size
components.description: Sets how much space a tab character occupies in preformatted text, taking a number of spaces or a width, and defaulting to 8.

components.name: table-layout
components.description: Chooses the algorithm a browser uses to lay out table rows, cells and columns; fixed ignores content and relies on declared widths for much faster rendering.

components.name: text-align
components.description: Aligns the inline content inside a block element with left, right, center, justify or the direction-aware start and end values.

components.name: text-align-last
components.description: Controls the alignment of the last, or only, line of a paragraph right before a forced line break, independently of the preceding lines.

components.name: text-box
components.description: Experimental shorthand for text-box-trim and text-box-edge, choosing in one declaration where and how much whitespace is trimmed from a line of text.

components.name: text-box-edge
components.description: Picks the text edge — such as cap or alphabetic — used with text-box-trim to remove the leftover whitespace above and below text.

components.name: text-combine-upright
components.description: Combines several characters into the space of one in a vertical writing mode, the Japanese tate-chū-yoko effect used for short numeric runs.

components.name: text-decoration
components.description: Shorthand for the decorative lines on text — combining line, color, style and thickness to produce underlines, overlines and strikethroughs.

components.name: text-decoration-skip
components.description: Specifies where an underline, overline or strike-through should break to improve legibility; deprecated in favor of the newer text-decoration-skip-* properties.

components.name: text-emphasis
components.description: Emphasizes text by drawing special marks beside it rather than bolding or italicizing, shorthand for text-emphasis-style and text-emphasis-color and common in East Asian typesetting.

components.name: text-indent
components.description: Pushes the first line of text inward by a set amount, measured from the block container's starting edge, with hanging and each-line modifiers.

components.name: text-justify
components.description: Sets how justified text is stretched — inter-word, inter-character, auto or none — and only applies when text-align is justify.

components.name: text-orientation
components.description: Aligns and rotates whole lines of text under a vertical writing-mode, with mixed rotating horizontal-script glyphs 90 degrees and upright keeping every character upright.

components.name: text-rendering
components.description: Tells the rendering engine whether to optimize text for speed, legibility or geometric precision; despite being an SVG property it is commonly applied to HTML.

components.name: text-transform
components.description: Controls the rendered case of text with lowercase, uppercase, capitalize or none, transforming the display without touching the underlying source.

components.name: text-underline-offset
components.description: Sets how far an underline sits from its text once text-decoration: underline is applied, accepting lengths, percentages or auto and negative values.

components.name: text-underline-position
components.description: Sets where an underline is drawn relative to the text, with under adding space so it clears descenders and left/right serving vertical writing modes.

components.name: text-wrap-mode
components.description: Decides whether text wraps onto new lines or stays on one line and possibly overflows; it is a constituent property of both white-space and text-wrap.

components.name: timeline-scope
components.description: Expands a named view or scroll timeline beyond its own descendants so a sibling element's scroll position can drive an unrelated animation.

components.name: transition
components.description: Shorthand for transition-property, -duration, -timing-function, -delay and -behavior, animating a value change such as a hover background color over a set duration.

components.name: unicode-bidi
components.description: Works with direction to control how browsers render bidirectional text mixing left-to-right and right-to-left scripts, with embed, isolate and bidi-override values.

components.name: unicode-range
components.description: Tells @font-face which characters a font face covers so the browser only downloads it when the page actually contains matching code points.

components.name: vertical-align
components.description: Controls how inline and inline-block elements sitting next to each other on a line are lined up, with values from baseline and middle to sub, super and text-top.

components.name: view-timeline-axis
components.description: Sets whether a view timeline tracks horizontal or vertical scrolling, and is declared on the animated element rather than the scroll container itself.

components.name: view-timeline-inset
components.description: Shrinks or expands the region where an element counts as in view, so a scroll-driven animation can begin and end at an offset rather than exactly at the scrollport edge.

components.name: view-timeline-name
components.description: Names the view timeline of an element so animations can be bound to its scroll position as it enters the scrollport of an ancestor scroll container.

components.name: visibility
components.description: Hides an element without changing the layout — it still occupies space — and can collapse table rows and columns; unlike opacity it is not inherited, so children can override it.

components.name: white-space
components.description: Controls how text is handled on an element — whether it wraps, whether line breaks and runs of spaces are preserved (pre) or collapsed (normal).

components.name: widows
components.description: Sets the minimum number of paragraph lines allowed to fall to a new page or column, the counterpart to orphans which governs the old page.

components.name: width
components.description: Specifies the width of an element's content area, accepting any length value and the min-width and max-width properties that constrain it.

components.name: word-break
components.description: Changes when line breaks occur, with break-all letting a word split at any character so a one-em-wide box can stack text vertically letter by letter.

components.name: word-spacing
components.description: Sets the space between words rather than letters; em units are recommended so the spacing scales with the font size, and it affects inline-block boxes too.

components.name: z-index
components.description: Controls the vertical stacking order of overlapping positioned elements, deciding which appears closest to the viewer; nesting creates contexts that cap a child's z-index.
